sec1_about1: “Education must begin with the solution of the student-teacher contradiction, by reconciling the poles of the contradiction so that both are simultaneously teachers and students.”
sec1_about2: The students of the academia are composed mainly of teenagers and adults who want to learn a foreign or local language together with a subject that he or she wants to explore. It can be from academic or vocational subjects.
sec1_about3: The students are highly valued at ACS MULINGUA. We consider that it is very important to help students feel valued in the learning process. A strong and secure environment is needed for the students to not only flourish academically but also in their personality and their affirmation. Either in group or as an individual, the student should feel at ease with their teachers and their mates during the class sessions. It is our responsibility as teachers to create the conditions that are needed for the students to participate actively in their own learning and not be passive recipients of knowledge. The horizontal relationship with students is favored to the vertical one which is authoritative and undemocratic.
sec1_about4: We are also aware that student´s emotions can sometimes interfere in their learning and affect their progress. Teachers should be ready to help when these situations arise. The horizontal relationship between teacher and student helps in this situation.
sec1_about5: To ensure that this policy is followed, students are given 2 permanent representatives at the managing committee of the academia. These 2 members are NOT among the teachers. They are present or past students and are elected by the registered students of the association. The latter are all students who are presently studying or have studied with the association before.  These 2 students are full-fledged members and have voting rights. They are responsible to collect the complaints from students and bring to the managing committee.
sec1_about6: Although we don´t encourage competition among students and prefer that students join together to learn, we do recognize that students who do additional efforts should be rewarded. The reward can be in the form of scholarship, special certificates or other form of recognition.
sec1_about7: Students who fail will have a special attention to encourage them to continue with their studies and never give up. Their cases will be analyzed and followed with suggestions and recommendations. No students should feel that they are failures.
sec1_about8: Recommended websites to explore more the horizontal relationship with the students or learner-centered teaching.
